strings.name: Ronaldo
strings.summary: Ronaldo Nazário became known for speed and finishing at clubs including Cruzeiro, Barcelona, Inter and Real Madrid. An unused member of Brazil’s 1994 champion squad, he returned from injury to score eight goals in the 2002 World Cup victory and won two Ballons d’Or. Serious knee injuries interrupted his career. After retiring in 2011 he invested in clubs and sold his controlling Valladolid stake in 2025.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones verifiable through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: A member of two World Cup-winning squads and a Ballon d’Or winner who shaped the technical standards of the modern striker.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Formation and training
strings.facts.f2.value: Developed through youth football and futsal; joined Cruzeiro’s first team in 1993.
strings.highlights.h1.title: World Cup-winning squads
strings.highlights.h1.text: Unused in 1994; eight goals, Golden Boot and title in 2002.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Two Ballons d’Or
strings.highlights.h2.text: Won in 1997 and 2002, alongside three FIFA World Player awards.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Club stake sale
strings.timeline.t1.text: Announced transfer of his majority Valladolid stake to investors.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Retirement
strings.timeline.t2.text: Ended his professional playing career at Corinthians.
strings.timeline.t3.title: World Cup comeback
strings.timeline.t3.text: Eight goals helped Brazil win; joined Madrid and won another Ballon d’Or.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Knee injury recurred
strings.timeline.t4.text: Suffered another serious knee injury on his Inter comeback.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Inter and Ballon d’Or
strings.timeline.t5.text: Joined Inter and won his first Ballon d’Or.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Barcelona spell
strings.timeline.t6.text: Joined Barcelona and became FIFA World Player that year.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Europe and Brazil
strings.timeline.t7.text: Joined PSV and Brazil’s World Cup-winning squad without playing.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Professional start
strings.timeline.t8.text: Began senior professional football at Cruzeiro.
